info.name: Gazebo - Product Templates
info.description:
# Gazebo Product Templates

One-shot create for catalog templates used by Add new product.

Creates the core `product` row **and** satellite rows (`product_packaging`, `product_shelf_life`, `product_flags`, `product_production`, `product_costing`) in one transaction, so the UI does not chain five PUTs.

**Tables:** `product`, `product_packaging`, `product_shelf_life`, `product_flags`, `product_production`, `product_costing`

## Routes
`POST /product/sleeving/`, `POST /product/high-risk/`

Core / General / Raw material / Packaging still use `POST /product/`.

## Auth
1. Run **Login** in Gazebo - RBAC Users (`POST /auth/login/`)
2. Copy `data.id_token` into `{{id_token}}`
3. Both routes need `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}`

## Envelope
Success: `{ "status": "success", "message": "...", "data": ... }`
Error: `{ "status": "error", "message": "...", "data": null }`

## Vars
`{{base_url}}`, `{{id_token}}`, `{{product_id}}`

item.name: Product Templates
item.description:
Create-only template POSTs for Sleeving and High risk.

**Tables:** `product` + satellites listed above.

**Vars:** `{{id_token}}`, `{{product_id}}` (saved from `data.ref`)

request.description:
### Create sleeving product

`POST /product/sleeving/`

Create-only template for **Cased / Sleeving** items. Writes the core `product` row plus packaging, shelf life, flags, production, and costing in one transaction.

Use this when the UI template is Sleeving (e.g. a 4 × 400 g sleeve that ships from Sleeving to Dispatch). Do **not** send derived fields: the server computes `pack_weight` and `costing.case_size_description` from the three case-size boxes.

Updates stay on `PATCH /product/:id/` plus the satellite PUTs.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

Core (same as `POST /product/`):

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | Internal item name |
| `product_class_id` | yes | Existing `product_class` PK |
| `category_id` | yes | Existing `product_category` PK (typical: Cased Items) |
| `unit_id` | yes | Goods-out unit PK (typical: Case) |
| `source_container_id` | yes | Location PK — source / Container OUT |
| `destination_container_id` | yes | Location PK — destination / Container IN |
| `storage_regime` | yes | `ambient`, `chilled`, `frozen`, or `non_food` |
| `alternate_name` | no | Alternative item name |
| `recipe_code` | no | Internal recipe / product code |
| `alternate_recipe_code` | no | Alternative recipe code |
| `external_barcode` | no | Barcode |
| `label_mode` | no | Default `product`. Also `per_unit`, `batch` |

Sleeving extras:

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `items_per_unit` | yes | Units per case (box 1). Must be > 0 |
| `unitary_weight` | yes | Weight of each unit (box 2). Must be > 0 |
| `case_size_unit_id` | yes | Weight unit PK (box 3). Name is baked into the case-size label; no extra FK stored |
| `shelf_life_days` | yes | Client shelf life in days |
| `shelf_life_depot_days` | no | Depot days |
| `force_trace_number` | no | Default `false`. Production date and use-by are always forced on |
| `default_resource_id` | no | Default production line (`planning` resource PK) |

Server-derived (do not send):

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| `packaging.pack_weight` | `items_per_unit × unitary_weight` (no unit conversion) |
| `costing.case_size_description` | `"{qty} x {weight} {UNIT}"` e.g. `4 x 400 GRAMS` |

Flag defaults written: `is_sales_item`, `has_plan`, `include_in_projections` all **true**.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Bearer {{id_token}}` |
| `Content-Type` | yes | `application/json` |

### Response body

`message`: `Product created successfully.`  
`data`: core product detail plus nested `packaging`, `shelf_life`, `flags`, `production`, `costing`. `data.ref` is the new product id (same as `data.id`). Test script saves it to `{{product_id}}`.

Example: 4 × 400 grams → `pack_weight` `1600`, `case_size_description` `4 x 400 GRAMS`.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 201 | Product + satellites created |
| 400 | Invalid JSON, missing/invalid fields, unknown unit/category/location, or integrity error |
| 401 | Not signed in |

### Create high risk product

`POST /product/high-risk/`

Create-only template for **Packed / High risk** items. Writes the core `product` row plus packaging, optional shelf life, flags, production, and a costing stub in one transaction.

Use this when the UI template is High risk (e.g. a tray that leaves High Risk for Sleeving). Packed items are **not** sold: `is_sales_item` and `include_in_projections` are forced **false**.

Updates stay on `PATCH /product/:id/` plus the satellite PUTs.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

Core (same as `POST /product/`):

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | Internal item name |
| `product_class_id` | yes | Existing `product_class` PK |
| `category_id` | yes | Existing `product_category` PK (typical: Packed Items) |
| `unit_id` | yes | Goods-out unit PK |
| `source_container_id` | yes | Location PK — source / Container OUT (typical: High Risk) |
| `destination_container_id` | yes | Location PK — destination / Container IN (typical: Sleeving) |
| `storage_regime` | yes | `ambient`, `chilled`, `frozen`, or `non_food` |
| `alternate_name` | no | Alternative item name |
| `recipe_code` | no | Internal recipe / product code |
| `alternate_recipe_code` | no | Alternative recipe code |
| `label_mode` | no | Default `product` |

High-risk extras:

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `pack_weight` | yes | Tray weight. Must be > 0 |
| `is_gas_flush` | no | Default **true** if omitted |
| `shelf_life_days` | no | If set, creates a `product_shelf_life` row. Force flags stay at model defaults |
| `avg_staff_min_per_unit` | no | Labour minutes per unit |
| `avg_staff_per_minute` | no | Staff per minute |

`tray_id` / `container_vessel_id` are **not** taken from this body — both stay null unless later set via `PUT /product/:id/packaging/`.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Bearer {{id_token}}` |
| `Content-Type` | yes | `application/json` |

### Response body

`message`: `Product created successfully.`  
`data`: core product detail plus nested `packaging`, `shelf_life` (null if days omitted), `flags`, `production`, `costing`. `data.ref` is the new product id. Test script saves it to `{{product_id}}`.

Example: `pack_weight` `1.25` + omitted gas flush → `packaging.is_gas_flush` true, `flags.is_sales_item` false.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 201 | Product + satellites created |
| 400 | Invalid JSON, missing/invalid fields, unknown category/unit/location, or integrity error |
| 401 | Not signed in |
